content:
samir: Heads-up — ruby-sampleapp CI started failing on main after yesterday's bundle update. Intermittent failing spec: `spec/auth_retry_spec.rb` (retries when token refresh returns 401). Fails ~30% of runs. Not reproduced locally yet.

samir: CI log excerpt:```
E, [2026-03-22T14:05:12.123Z] ERROR -- : TokenRefreshError: 401 unauthorized
#<Thread:0x00007f9b8c0> run at auth_retry.rb:47
...
Timeout::Error: connection timed out waiting for reconnect
```

elaine: ugh, that flake again. Can you paste the failing job link and the exact bundle change? I can triage the test and add the flaky label.

samir: job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/actions/runs/1234567890 (private link)
bundle diff: bumped `faraday` 1.10 -> 2.0 and `net-http-persistent` 3.0 -> 4.0. Also small change in our HTTP adapter wiring.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @samir — job queued. :arrows_counterclockwise:

juan: my hunch: Faraday 2.0 changed default behavior for adapter timeouts and connection reuse. The 4.0 net-http-persistent had a different socket eviction cadence. Tests that assume immediate reconnect can race.

juan: quick check: does the test stub the token endpoint or rely on a real short-lived token? If it hits a local server and we return 401 then immediately 200 the client might not clear the connection and the retry path hangs.

samir: test uses a webmock stub but we do `allow_any_instance_of(HTTP).to receive(:request).and_call_original` in one spec — kinda messy.

matt: short-term: mark the spec as flaky and add `retry: 3` in the rspec metadata for CI runs until we fix. Long-term: update the sampleapp to use explicit connection reset on auth refresh path.

elaine: propose a minimal patch: in the auth retry helper, after a 401+refresh sequence call `client.reset_connection!` (wrapper for `Net::HTTP#finish` + reopen) — and add a test that stubs the socket layer. Patch snippet:```ruby
# lib/redwood/http_client.rb
def reset_connection!
  if @conn && @conn.respond_to?(:finish)
    @conn.finish rescue nil
    @conn = nil
  end
end
```
This avoids relying on adapter internals.

samir: I can whip up a small PR. Will also add `:flake` label and a short CI matrix entry to run ruby 3.1/3.2 on GH actions.

elaine: thanks — please include changelog note and mark as `chore(ruby): minor compat` so we can backport to the maintenance branch if needed. Also add a tiny test that asserts `reset_connection!` is called after refresh.

samir: opened PR #482: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/482 — includes `reset_connection!`, test, and CI matrix tweak. PTAL.

juan: quick review: code looks fine. One nit: use `@conn&.closed?` check before finish to avoid double-finish on some net-http-persistent versions.

samir: fixed the nit and pushed. CI rerun passed on the green run.

matt: can we add a tiny smoke e2e in our devex pipeline that spins up the sampleapp and runs the auth refresh flow once? That would catch this class of change early.

elaine: yes, add `smoke:auth-refresh` job that runs on PRs for ruby/* paths. Keep it quick (single scenario).

samir: done, added smoke job to PR. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Job #1234567890 rerun: successful.

elaine: moving to close after backport to `release/1.4.x`. cc @matt for release notes.

samir: tagging release note: "ruby-sampleapp: make HTTP client resilient to connection reuse after auth refresh (compat with Faraday 2.x/net-http-persistent 4.x)"

matt: ack. good catch and nice minimal fix.
